faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about ShadcnStore components, licensing, and integration. Still have questions? We're here to help!
faq.stillHaveQuestions: Still have questions? We're here to help.

item1.question: How do I integrate ShadcnStore components into my project?
item1.answer: Integration is simple! All our components are built with shadcn/ui and work with React, Next.js, and Vite. Just copy the component code, install any required dependencies, and paste it into your project. Each component comes with detailed installation instructions and examples.

item2.question: What's the difference between free and premium components?
item2.answer: Free components include essential UI elements like buttons, forms, and basic layouts. Premium components offer advanced features like complex data tables, analytics dashboards, authentication flows, and complete admin templates. Premium also includes Figma files, priority support, and commercial licenses.

item3.question: Can I use these components in commercial projects?
item3.answer: Yes! Free components come with an MIT license for unlimited use. Premium components include a commercial license that allows usage in client projects, SaaS applications, and commercial products without attribution requirements.

item4.question: Do you provide support and updates?
item4.answer: Absolutely! We provide community support for free components through our Discord server and GitHub issues. Premium subscribers get priority email support, regular component updates, and early access to new releases. We also maintain compatibility with the latest shadcn/ui versions.

item5.question: What frameworks and tools do you support?
item5.answer: Our components work with React 18+, Next.js 13+, and Vite. We use TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and follow shadcn/ui conventions. Components are tested with popular tools like React Hook Form, TanStack Query, and Zustand for state management.

item6.question: How often do you release new components?
item6.answer: We release new components and templates weekly. Premium subscribers get early access to new releases, while free components are updated regularly based on community feedback. You can track our roadmap and request specific components through our GitHub repository.
